reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: p0200 ('Each party is free to enter into similar agreements with others') affirmatively preserves Customer's freedom to procure from other suppliers, matching the preferred position.
No exclusivity, sole-source, requirements-purchase, or minimum-volume covenant binds Customer in the cited paragraphs; the deterministic check confirms no sole-supplier obligation remains.

The rationale correctly distinguishes the resale restriction in p0190 as a scope-of-use limit rather than an exclusive-dealing covenant, and correctly treats the 'exclusive' hits (taxes, warranty disclaimer, nonexclusive license) as unrelated to dealing restrictions.
Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline or counterparty comment was proposed and none is required; the rendered text is unchanged from the original.
